summary: Recent updates to the Gecko Media Plugins (GMP) for Firefox focus on enhancing the stability and compatibility of media playback features. By caching the event target in GMPParent, developers have addressed a potential deadlock issue that could occur during startup, ensuring a smoother user experience. Additionally, improvements have been made to the Chromium Content Decryption Module (CDM), which is integral for handling DRM (Digital Rights Management) content securely, helping Firefox stay in line with the latest standards and improving playback for protected media. This combination of updates reinforces the overall reliability and functionality of streaming services in Firefox, which matters greatly for users reliant on watching online videos and accessing secure content.
